posts.caption:
Many of you have told us the same thing lately: you're exhausted, wired at night, and struggling to switch off—even when you're sitting on the couch.

Here's what we know from functional medicine: poor sleep isn't just tiredness. It cascades. Chronic sleep debt compromises immune recovery, mood regulation, and how your body processes stress. The longer you run on empty, the harder it becomes to refill the tank.

The good news? Your sleep architecture can be rebuilt. We work with clients to identify what's actually keeping them awake—whether it's blood sugar dysregulation, circadian misalignment, or nervous system dysregulation—and address the root.

If sleep has become a real battle, let's chat about what's underneath.

Book an appointment or reply with your biggest sleep challenge—we'd love to help.

#SleepAndRecovery #FunctionalMedicine #AdelaideClinic #WellnessFromTheInside

- Below the headline, place a prominent accent bar (soft sage, warm cream, or soft grey-blue — harmonizing with #39B54A, not clashing). Inside this bar, centre white or charcoal text (one phrase, e.g. "WHAT THE SCIENCE SAYS") in a supporting weight (Satoshi Medium, ~60px).
- Small EHN green anchor element (logo lockup or a subtle green accent line) positioned upper-right, subtle and unobtrusive.
- Dark semi-transparent charcoal or soft overlay at the bottom (not pure black), creating a readable zone for caption text or CTA.
- Overall aesthetic: clinical, authority-based, warm and grounded — matching the winner's medical-professional register.

Colour palette (EHN-branded, harmonizing with #39B54A):
- Primary visual anchor: EHN green #39B54A (logo, accent bar underline, or a subtle green border/rule).
- Secondary colour for accent bar: soft sage, warm cream, or a muted grey-blue (chosen to complement green, never clash).
- Background: warm cream, soft sage, or neutral charcoal (never pure black, never the competitor's warm wood-and-red palette).
- Text: white or charcoal (high contrast), Satoshi Bold for headline, Satoshi Medium for supporting text.
- Overlay: semi-transparent charcoal (professional, readable).

Specific instructions for the designer:
1. Shoot or select a lifestyle/clinic image: a clinician speaking, a peaceful clinical interior, or a wellness-focused lifestyle shot (Australian editorial feel — natural light, warm tones, grounded).
2. Apply a soft blur or vignette to the background so the subject stands out.
3. Position the headline "5 DAYS TO" + "METABOLIC RESET" in Satoshi Bold (~95px) in the upper-center, with strong contrast against the background.
4. Below, add a horizontal accent bar (soft sage, cream, or grey-blue) spanning ~60% of the card width, centred. Inside, set white or charcoal text "WHAT THE SCIENCE SAYS" in Satoshi Medium (~60px), vertically and horizontally centred.
5. Place the EHN logo lockup or a small green accent element in the upper-right corner (opacity ~80%, unobtrusive).
6. Layer a semi-transparent dark overlay (charcoal, ~40% opacity) at the bottom ~25% of the card, creating a readable zone for the brand close line or CTA.
7. Ensure all text sits at >=36px (headline >=95px, supporting text ~60px, any caption ~40px).
8. Match the winner's whitespace ratio: generous top/side margins, tight-to-medium text density within the overlay zone.
9. Brand close line (bottom-right or lower-center, white Satoshi Medium ~40px): "Elemental Health & Nutrition" in the dark overlay zone.
10. Overall feel: professional, warm, grounded — not stock-wellness, not overly stylised. Match the winner's authority register.

Do NOT use the competitor's colours (red/crimson, warm wood tones, or white-on-wood aesthetic). Render the entire design in EHN's complementary palette anchored to green #39B54A.

When I see someone with SIBO, herbal medicines are often part of the toolkit — not the whole story, but a meaningful piece of it.

Tinctures extracted from plants like andrographis, oregano and wormwood have research behind them for supporting a resilient gut barrier and helping rebalance the microbial landscape. That's where the conversation starts: not "take this herb and you'll be fine," but "let's use this alongside everything else to help your gut find its way back."

If you suspect SIBO or are navigating ongoing gut symptoms, a functional-medicine approach can help untangle the drivers. We're here to listen and build a plan that makes sense for *your* body.

Book a consultation with us to explore what might help.

- Hero shot: Warm, naturally lit kitchen or dining scene (cream, timber, soft textures). Grounded editorial aesthetic—Australian natural tones, no synthetic styling.
- Text hook: Large bold headline positioned upper-centre, ONE key word in green #39B54A italic (Satoshi Bold, ~95px+). Secondary text in white or cream for contrast against the scene.
- Listicle visual: 5 items arranged in a simple, uncluttered grid or row on a neutral surface (marble, timber, ceramic—not glass jars). Each item represents one slide/beat.
- Slide structure (if carousel): 5 slides, one item per slide. Each slide shows the item + a SHORT functional label (one line, Satoshi Medium, >=40px body text). Soft, paced transitions (~2–3 sec per slide).
- Colour palette: EHN green #39B54A as primary anchor in text/accent lines. Secondary palette: cream, soft sage, charcoal, natural timber. Harmonizes with green; never clashes. Avoid pure white or pure black backgrounds; favour warm off-white, cream, or soft muted tones.
- Typography: Satoshi Bold for headline (with one word in green italic); Satoshi Medium for body labels. Headline ~95px+, body >=40px. No sub-36px text anywhere.
- Close line: "Elemental Health & Nutrition" in green #39B54A, small and positioned bottom corner.
- Overall feel: Editorial, clinical-warm, grounded in natural light and authentic textures. High production but never trendy or artificial. Prioritises legibility and functional clarity over visual noise.

REUSABLE PLACEHOLDERS:
- [Headline]: One main benefit/topic (e.g. "5 Foods for [Health Goal]")
- [Key Word]: One word highlighted in green italic (e.g. "Balance", "Energy", "Hormone")
- [Item 1–5]: Food/ingredient name
- [Label 1–5]: One-line functional benefit (e.g. "—Iron & Folate", "—Omega-3s")
- [Supporting text]: Optional secondary hook or tagline
- Close line: Always "Elemental Health & Nutrition"
